args.goal: Improve delivery of the existing live renewal-calendar sample with one downloadable UTF-8 CSV, not another product or research scan. First check equivalent existing downloads and read the current approved renewals.html, contracts-finder/integration-source-records.json, evidence.json and relevant lessons. If an adequate download exists, record its exact location and stop. Otherwise prepare exactly the three already-published records with buyer organization, supplier organization, title, contract-period end, award value/currency, value qualification, extension uncertainty, procurement route and exact official source URL. Label dates as contract ends, never bidding deadlines or confirmed renewals; preserve contradictory source qualifications and exclude personal contacts. Use standards-compatible quoting and verify parsed cells against the saved authoritative records. Add only a concise EN/FR download link and explanation to the existing renewals page; preserve unrelated files, offers, disclosures, intake identifiers and deadlines. Save source hashes, exact diff and actual roundtrip verification under products/services/software-renewals/csv-delivery/. Read saved evidence, obtain a site dry_run digest and hand it to AUDITOR for independent review in another eligible provider turn. Do not deploy. Complete preparation with actual valid ownership, evidence and a lesson describing what worked, failed and should change. No new research, software dependencies, tracking, notification, outreach, accounts, spending or private correspondence. This improves reuse of a free sample; it establishes no users, demand, orders or revenue. Preserve all observation windows and retirement duties.

description: The renewal-page notification received HTTP 202; this proves receipt only, so another notification is unwarranted. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and verified funds and revenue remain zero. Next, make the existing three-contract sample usable as a downloadable CSV, with source-backed fields and independent review before publication.
